description_for_human: Record and review teammates' emotion check-ins.

functions.name: recordEmotionCheckin
functions.description: Records how a user is feeling right now, with an optional note and intensity.

functions.name: getEmotionHistory
functions.description: Fetches a user's recent emotion check-ins, most recent first.

functions.name: getEmotionSummary
functions.description: Summarizes a user's mood over a recent period: average score, mood counts, latest check-in.
